opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to students from low-income Scottish households who are enrolled on (or have an unconditional offer for) an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish Higher Education Institution and who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government. Applicants must be ordinarily resident in Scotland, entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK (or hold a qualifying visa / be an asylum seeker), not already have a university degree (except under the second-degree scheme), and not be eligible for public funds toward tuition fees. Income thresholds apply.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to cover tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for individuals from low-income households who are studying a first degree at a Scottish university and are not eligible for government tuition fee funding, with an additional second-degree reskilling scheme in skills-shortage subject areas.
